title: Celigo ediprofile
description:
EDI profile configuration. The `fileType` field determines which set of
interchange control fields apply (X12 ISA/GS or EDIFACT UNB) and is
immutable after creation. Fields for the other standard are ignored.
x-celigo-ai-guidance: Request schema for creating or updating an EDI profile.

name.description: Human-readable name for the EDI profile
x-celigo-ai-guidance: Name the profile after the trading partner and EDI standard whose interchange identity it carries (e.g. "Acme Corp X12 Profile"), not after a flow's purpose — one partner's profile is reused by every document exchange with that partner.

description.description: Detailed description of the EDI profile's purpose
examples: X12 interchange profile for Acme Corp trading partner

fileType.description: The EDI standard this profile is configured for. Immutable after creation.

tpInterchangeId.description: Trading partner's interchange identifier (ISA06 for X12, UNB sender/receiver ID for EDIFACT)

controlNumber.description: Current interchange control number. Incremented with each interchange sent.

tpIdQualifier.description: Trading partner ID qualifier. For X12 (ISA05/ISA07): 01 (DUNS), 08 (UCC EDI), 12 (phone), 14 (DUNS+4), ZZ (mutually defined), etc. For EDIFACT: 14 (EAN), ZZZ (mutually defined), etc.

myIdQualifier.description: Your (sender/receiver) ID qualifier. Same enum as tpIdQualifier.

isa11.description: X12 ISA11 - Repetition Separator (or Interchange Control Standards Identifier in older versions). Single character.

isa12.description: X12 ISA12 - Interchange Control Version Number (5 characters)

isa16.description: X12 ISA16 - Component Element Separator. Single character.

tpGroupId.description: X12 GS02 - Trading partner's application sender/receiver code

myGroupId.description: X12 GS03 - Your application sender/receiver code

unb010_0002.description: EDIFACT UNB S001/0002 - Syntax Version Number.

versionNumber.description: EDIFACT message version number (e.g., "D" for directory).
